mapper.select: SELECT id, name FROM sys_dept ORDER BY id

SELECT d.id, d.real_name AS realName, d.title, d.fee, d.expertise, s.name AS deptName, (d.stock - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_appointment b WHERE b.doctor_id = d.id AND b.visit_date = #{date} )) AS rest FROM sys_doctor d LEFT JOIN sys_dept s ON d.dept_id = s.id
AND s.name = #{deptName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_appointment WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND visit_date = #{date}
SELECT stock FROM sys_doctor WHERE id = #{doctorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_appointment (patient_id, doctor_id,dept_id, visit_date, time_slot,slot, create_time, status,fee) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{doctorId},#{deptId}, #{appointmentDate},#{timeSlot}, #{slot}, #{createTime}, #{status},#{fee})
